title: Ally Appears
next_chapter_hook: The fading figure's words rang like thunder—the confrontation between the Imperial Court forces and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets was far more ancient than Chen Ji had ever known. And when Chen Ji opened his eyes once more, an unexpected inheritance awaited him.

text.content: In the abyss-like darkness, Chen Ji's consciousness drifted like a withered leaf, floating and sinking in the endless Void. The golden light of the fourth page of the Tianji Record became the only beacon in this pitch black, as the outline of the complete Tianji Record slowly emerged, as if an ancient beast were awakening. And deepest within the golden light, that cold eye still gazed upon him, bearing pressure and scrutiny beyond mortal limits—the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. Chen Ji finally realized that from the very beginning, he had been nothing more than a piece moved about on this chessboard.

At the same time, on the battlefield beyond the abyss, Ye Qing's slender figure stood guard before Chen Ji. The Demonic Path mist churned around her, yet could not conceal the thickening scent of blood. The footsteps of the Holy Sect pursuers drew ever closer—seven presences in total, each at least Foundation Building later stage. A trace of blood seeped from the corner of Ye Qing's lips; moments ago, forcibly channeling the Demonic Path mist to shield Chen Ji had worsened her injuries.

dialogue.content: "Demonic witch, do you think you alone can withstand the Seven Excellencies of the Holy Sect?" The leading pursuer coldly laughed, the blade in his hand gleaming with eerie purple light. "Surrender that boy and the Tianji Record Fragment, and the Holy Sect may still leave your corpse intact!"

text.content: Ye Qing offered no reply, merely slowly raising her black纱 folding fan. The blood-red Manjusaka embroidered on its surface bloomed妖异 under the moonlight. Her gaze was icy as frost, yet the corner of her mouth curved into a hint of mockery—threats of this caliber, she had heard far too many times during her years in the Holy Sect. Every person who had spoken such words had ultimately died beneath her fan. But now, did she truly have to fight with her life on the line for the waste behind her?

Just then, a sudden transformation occurred. A cyan sword light slashed down from the Void, carrying vast righteous energy, directly wounding the two leading pursuers so severely they were nearly cleaved in two. The sword light's凌厉 was as if it could tear apart the heavens themselves, the air itself sliced by a sharp whistle. All seven pursuers halted simultaneously, their faces filled with terror as they turned toward the source of that sword light—a middle-aged man in cyan robes was slowly approaching, each step seeming to trample upon their hearts.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's pupils slightly contracted. This aura… it far exceeded her imagination. Instinctively she tightened her grip on the fan, yet in the next instant she sensed that the sword intent held no malice, but instead carried a steadiness so familiar it sent a chill through her heart. A thought suddenly flashed through her mind—this sword intent bore a striking resemblance to the sealed power within Chen Ji!

"Who are you, to dare obstruct Holy Sect business!" The leading pursuer's bravado masked his fear, the blade in his hand trembling. That middle-aged man's aura was far too terrifying—as if with merely a single thought, he could slaughter all seven of them. The middle-aged man didn't even glance at him, merely speaking calmly, his voice low yet carrying undeniable authority: "The Holy Sect's reach has grown far too long."

text.content: Before his words even finished, another sword light descended. This strike was even more凌厉 than before, carrying the resolve to annihilate everything. All seven pursuers simultaneously spat blood, their bodies hurled dozens of zhang away by the sword intent, crashing heavily to the ground, unable to move. Having done this, that middle-aged man finally turned, his gaze falling upon the unconscious Chen Ji. A complex mix of emotions flickered in his eyes—relief, heartache, and a trace of barely perceptible guilt.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing forced herself forward despite her injuries, the killing intent within her扇骨 surging, and asked in a low voice: "Who exactly are you? This sword intent… is not something an ordinary cultivator could possess. More importantly, why are you saving him?" Her intuition told her that this mysterious figure's appearance was by no means coincidence, and especially that familiar aura compelled her to raise her guard.

text.content: The middle-aged man finally looked directly at Ye Qing, the corner of his mouth slightly lifting into a meaningful smile: "Little girl, your Demonic Path mist cultivation is quite impressive. To be able to conceal the aura of the Tianji Record—this talent is indeed rare." His words sent a jolt through Ye Qing's heart—he actually knew the true purpose of the Demonic Path mist? This was absolutely a secret beyond ordinary knowledge!

dialogue.content: "You… what is your relationship with Chen Ji?" Ye Qing's voice slightly trembled; an incredible notion was rising within her. That spineless waste she had always looked down upon, the man she had deemed merely a minor piece on the chessboard—could he possibly have some unknown background? The aura emanating from this mysterious figure matched the sealed power within Chen Ji to a striking degree—could it be that…

text.content: The middle-aged man did not answer directly. Instead, he walked to Chen Ji's side and placed a single hand upon his forehead. A gentle Spiritual Energy flowed into Chen Ji's body, resonating with the golden light of the Tianji Record. The unconscious Chen Ji's brow slightly furrowed, as if feeling something within his dream. Meanwhile, an aged voice rang out from the Void—it was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul!

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a tremor, as if witnessing something utterly impossible: "This aura… you are… impossible! Weren't you supposed to have…" The middle-aged man smiled faintly: "Greetings, Master. It has been a while. I didn't expect you to still remember me after twenty years." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul violently fluctuated in the Void, seemingly too excited to speak.

text.content: As Ye Qing listened to their exchange, her mind buzzed with confusion. Twenty years ago? That was before Chen Ji was even born! Who exactly was this mysterious figure? What connection did he have with Chen Ji, with the Tianji Record, with Mo Xiansheng? Countless questions surged within her heart, but more than anything, she felt a surge of betrayed fury—Chen Ji, that waste, had clearly been hiding something from the very start!

choice.prompt: The mysterious benefactor revealed his identity to Ye Qing and asked whether she would be willing to temporarily become Chen Ji's guardian. Ye Qing needed to make a choice.

choices.description: Ye Qing chose to trust this mysterious figure and officially become Chen Ji's guardian, while obtaining intelligence on the Imperial Court forces.
choices.visible_cost: Need to bear greater risks and responsibilities
choices.visible_reward: Obtain preliminary intelligence on the Imperial Court forces and understand a broader world
choices.risk_hint: Identity may be exposed, and the conflict with the Holy Sect will become even more acute

dialogue.content: Ye Qing put away her fan, her expression complex as she glanced at Chen Ji. Finally, she nodded: "Very well, I'll trust you for now. But you must tell me—what exactly is your relationship with this waste?" The middle-aged man stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze distant: "I am his father—Chen Xuan. Twenty years ago, when I passed the Tianji Record to him, I knew this day would come."

text.content: Chen Xuan! Ye Qing's pupils abruptly contracted. That waste Chen Ji, beneath that so-called firewood persona, actually had such an earth-shaking father? And the Tianji Record inheritance, the father's scheme, the son's concealment… all of this was a thousand times more intricate than she had ever imagined!

choices.description: Ye Qing expressed doubts about this mysterious figure's identity, demanding he prove his relationship with Chen Ji while retaining her own judgment.
choices.visible_cost: May miss out on important intelligence
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent judgment and不被他人左右
choices.risk_hint: The mysterious figure may therefore depart

dialogue.content: Ye Qing did not immediately agree, saying coldly: "Words are cheap. If you truly are Chen Ji's father, do you have proof?" The middle-aged man—Chen Xuan—heard this and laughed instead of showing anger: "The little girl is quite cautious." He waved his hand, and a streak of cyan light entered Ye Qing's brow center. It was a scene: when Chen Ji was young, a man was teaching him to write stroke by stroke, and that man's face was identical to Chen Xuan's.

text.content: After viewing that memory, Ye Qing's heart was deeply shaken. Although she remained vigilant, the warmth within that memory could not be faked. More importantly, she had glimpsed a crucial piece of information from this memory—Chen Xuan's布局 was far more profound than she had imagined. Twenty years ago, he had already begun arranging for today's situation, and this so-called waste Chen Ji had been a key piece on the chessboard from the very beginning!

Just then, Chen Xuan's expression suddenly hardened. He raised his head toward the Void, his brow knit tight: "Time is running out; the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' gaze grows stronger." He turned to look at the unconscious Chen Ji, a trace of reluctance flickering in his eyes. Then he channeled a streak of cyan light into Chen Ji's body: "This is the final gift I leave him. When he awakens, tell him—the war between the Imperial Court forces and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets is about to begin, and he is the key to determining victory or defeat."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing quickly pressed further: "What exactly are the Imperial Court forces? What grudge do they have with the Eye of Heavenly Secrets?" Chen Xuan's form had already begun to grow illusory, as if he might dissipate from this Void at any moment. He cast one final glance at Chen Ji, his voice low and grave: "In ancient times, there was a group of people unwilling to be pieces of Heaven. They established the Imperial Court and fought against the Eye of Heavenly Secrets for ten thousand years. Now, the war will flare up once more, and you… must guard him well for me."

text.content: As his words fell, Chen Xuan's form completely vanished, leaving only a streak of cyan light entering Chen Ji's body and an ancient Jade Pendant falling into Ye Qing's palm. Carved on the pendant was an ancient character "陈", while the back bore a fragmented map that seemed to point toward some mysterious location. Ye Qing gripped the Jade Pendant tightly, her heart churning with waves of shock—Imperial Court forces, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, a ten-thousand-year war… this information completely overturned her understanding of this world.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed, his voice carrying infinite emotion: "Chen Xuan… in the end, he still chose this path." Ye Qing pressed: "Master, you know him? Who exactly is he?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment before saying: "He was a candidate for the previous generation's Tianji Record inheritance, and also… Chen Ji's father. Twenty years ago, to protect the young Chen Ji, he voluntarily gave up the inheritance, sealing the Tianji Record into his son's body. He himself entered the Imperial Court and has fought against Heaven to this day."

Ye Qing finally understood. That so-called firewood Chen Ji had been protected by his father with the Tianji Record since the moment of his birth. His father had placed himself between the Eye of Heavenly Secrets and his son, using twenty years of concealment and scheming to buy his son time to grow. This fatherly love was so heavy it was suffocating. She looked down at the still unconscious Chen Ji, and for the first time, found the back of this "waste" to be so lonely and heavy.
